finding: Initial adapter joined components into one text cell rather than producing separate component boxes.
resolution: Require distinct cells with count-derived geometry and declared widths.

finding: Initial pod/matrix coordinates omitted parent slide offsets; body elements could occupy the title area.
resolution: Apply content-origin offsets and reserve legend space.

finding: Inverse profiles require foreground selection against actual cell fills, including fixed white footer.
resolution: Shared TextOn chooses readable navy/white; verify every native render.

finding: Milestone glyph could match active-period fill and disappear.
resolution: Bind milestone foreground and label contrast to actual interval fill.

finding: Independent panels allowed summary lengths to move activities and outputs to unequal vertical positions, despite passing fit.
resolution: Shared measured row grid across all process columns.

finding: Long milestone captions overflowed fixed 16pt height by 32pt and 44pt.
resolution: Allocate nonintersecting caption lanes across neighboring periods, bounded to42pt height, without reducing type size or shortening content.

finding: Native measurements fit, but a connector used the same accent color as a component surface.
resolution: Resolve connector ink against endpoint surfaces and validate routing for every fixture.

finding: Numeric gauge scales/targets and qualitative cell colors lacked visible explanations.
resolution: Add per-row scale/target labels and a four-status legend; vary target ranges in inverse dial example.

finding: Taxonomy-only matches labeled structurally incompatible radial/curve/chart sources as family_suitable.
resolution: Label taxonomy matches as category candidates requiring structural review; do not promote source templates from family examples.

finding: Native fit passed but milestone caption backgrounds erased interval bars; completed bars also lacked contrast in inverse mode.
resolution: Separate interval and caption lanes; qualify contrasting inverse interval boundaries.

finding: The linear actual-value needle extended one point into criterion and scale text lanes; text fit alone did not catch the overlap.
resolution: Bound needle protrusion to the track lane; all nine examples pass cached layout/fit checks.

finding: Edge-clamped three-period caption frames placed short labels far from their milestone stars, despite native fit and intact bars.
resolution: Default to one-period centered caption frames; use explicit wider spans for long captions.

finding: Linear criterion cells painted only text strips, leaving white gaps inside otherwise inverse rows.
resolution: Paint a continuous lower criterion pane under gauge and labels; preserve their geometry and typography.

finding: Content-sized grid rows occupied only the top of full-height layer surfaces; large gray regions hid most connector shafts.
resolution: Explicitly allocate row height to layer height and reserve visible inter-layer connector gaps.

finding: Responsibility-matrix background extended far below its measured rows, creating a large empty gray area.
resolution: Remove the unused full-container fill and retain alternating cell surfaces and white grid gaps.

finding: User found workstream text vertically centered over the whole row while the activity bar occupied a top lane. Root optical review missed the shared-y-axis error.
resolution: Align label and activity bar vertical centers; put milestone captions below that common activity lane. Recheck every roadmap variant, including multi-line labels.

finding: User could not tell whether far-left controls label the component rows; rail entry count differs from layer count and vertical distribution implied a correspondence.
resolution: Use explicit universal scope, compact grouped concerns, a dark vertical separator with 20pt gutter, Layer/Components column headers and attached centered layer-label bands.

finding: Matrix fixtures used RACI abbreviations without defining their meanings.
resolution: Added an explicit R/A/C/I footer legend to all five matrix examples; arbitrary matrix values still require caller-supplied explanations.

finding: Code review found hashlib imported in the catalog-version Python block rather than the separate evidence-copy block that uses it. A future install would fail at hash verification.
resolution: Moved hashlib import into the evidence-copy block. Installer syntax checked; current checkpoint files and hashes audited independently. Installation intentionally not run against frozen .3.

finding: PowerPoint reports dashed/right-angle SVG graphics as single line with exact width sentinel -2147483648. The package has no picture a:ln; the adapter rejected SVG internal mixed/unavailable stroke metadata as an invalid visible border.
resolution: Keep raw graphic line diagnostics. Require exact graphic/sentinel/SVG/no-outline conditions and independent package image-structure validation before allowing unavailable native outline metadata. Normal line and explicit-outline checks remain strict.
